title: Sun Yat Sen

page_data.en:
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
Shanghai Municipal Council
452
18/7/16
17th July 191●

Sir,

Dr. Sun Yat Sen gave a tea party to the
members of Parliament in the International
Institute at 2 p.m. 15th instant.

Huang Hsin is residing at No. 448 Avenue
Joffre, and Sun Yat Sen at No. 10 Route Voyron.

It is reported that the present Woosung
Garrison will soon leave for the North, and will
be replaced by men from the Arsenal. The news
of the proposed transfer has been well received
by the Woosung troops.

A public meeting convened by the Kuomintang
party will be held in Chang Su Ho Garden at
2 p.m. 17th instant.

Your obedient servant,
[签名]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
（印章：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））
上海工部局
452
18/7/16
191●年7月17日

先生：

孙中山博士于本月15日下午2时，在国际学会为国会议员举行茶话会。

黄兴现居住于霞飞路448号，孙中山居住于韦罗尼路10号。

据报，现任吴淞驻军即将开拔北上，并将由兵工厂的部队接替。这一拟议中的换防消息受到吴淞部队的欢迎。

国民党将于本月17日下午2时在张园召开公众大会。

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
总探长。

警务处总监。
